video_title: Stephen A. gives an EARLY PREDICTION for the Knicks vs. Spurs NBA Finals Matchup 👀 | SportsCenter

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith analyzes the New York Knicks' playoff dominance
quotes.excerpt: you've got a poised New York Knicks team, winners of 11 straight playoff games
quotes.quote: You've got a poised New York Knicks team, winners of 11 straight playoff games by an average of 23.8 points, simply annihilating the competition over the last 11 games or so, outscoring them by 262 points. This is what you're talking about when you talk about the New York Knicks. You're talking about one of the great players in the game today, in Jalen Brunson. A guy in Carl Anthony Towns that's a facilitator and a sniper from long range, with guys like OG Anunoby, Mikal Bridges, Josh Hart, and others who know their roles and have played it exceptionally well. And Mike Brown, who's a championship-tested coach, is a man that's got two rings as an assistant coach. He's coached in the NBA Finals before, and you know that he knows what he's doing.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith evaluates Victor Wembanyama's impact on the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: they got a 7-foot-5 alien by the name of Victor Wembanyama from France, who is all world
quotes.quote: Going against the San Antonio Spurs, their inexperience is something that the New York Knicks can try and lead on, but the reality is they got a 7-foot-5 alien by the name of Victor Wembanyama from France, who is all world. He showed up in this postseason and let everybody know who he is. And by the way, his supporting cast ain't shabby at all. Experience in Harrison Barnes, a champion, and De'Aaron Fox, who's been in Game 7s before. Young studs like Dylan Harper, Stephon Castle, Devin Vassell, you look at these guys and what they bring to the table, along with Keldon Johnson and Jeremy Sochan. They got a lot of weapons. They can win the championship. They're going to be the favorites to win the championship, considering the fact that they were in the better conference and they obviously had tougher competition in the conference finals going up against OKC.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith maintains his Knicks pick for the finals
quotes.excerpt: I ain't jumping off the ship with my New York Knicks. If there's a way, they will find it
quotes.quote: I have to sit up there and acknowledge that the San Antonio Spurs have been the better team during the regular season. They finished with 62 wins. They are justified to be the favorites to win this championship, considering the fact that they were in the better conference and they obviously had tougher competition in the conference finals going up against OKC. But damn it, I ain't jumping off the ship with my New York Knicks. If there's a way, they will find it. I believe in Jalen Brunson and Carl Anthony Towns and the crew, and I'm sticking with the Knicks, as always.
